{{Arachnotron}}
{{DISPLAYTITLE:Arachnotron (Doom II RPG)}}
'''Arachnotrons''' are an enemy class in [[Doom II RPG]].

They come in two forms (color swaps of the same model):

*Arachnotrons (has blue eyes)
*[[Spiderdemon/Doom II RPG|Spider Mastermind]] (has red eyes)

Both are fairly large and are mounted with chainguns.

The Spider Mastermind births three Arachnotrons upon death.
